name: airtable
description: Read and write operational data in Airtable — query, search, create, update, and delete records; manage tables, fields, and record comments; automate any routine Airtable workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, fields, records, and comments through an MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Imagine your agent being able to look up anything in your Airtable bases in real time — from open deals and project tasks to customer lists and content calendars. With this skill, your agent can find, create, update, and delete records, inspect your base structure, and even post comments, all in natural language. No more switching tabs or digging through spreadsheets: just ask your agent to check a status, add a row, or move a deal forward, and it happens on the spot.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started — show me all the bases and tables I have in Airtable.
Give me a quick summary of what's in each table across my workspace.
Find something in my Airtable that might need my attention today.
